name: Pine Forest
description: A dense forest containing pine trees, brush, and small streams.

name: Mountain Trail
description: A rocky path winding along a ridge with sparse vegetation and wide views.

name: Lakeshore
description: A quiet lake edge with reeds, driftwood, and a chance to fish.

name: Open Meadow
description: A sunny clearing filled with grasses, wildflowers, and berry bushes.

name: River Bend
description: A fast-moving stretch of river with a shallow crossing and plenty of fish.

name: Cave Entrance
description: A dark overhang that offers shelter from weather but may hide wildlife.
